subject: Next steps: Aurelia Labs POC — isolation diagram & compliance gaps
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: elena.rossi@aurelia-labs.com, mike.turner@aurelia-labs.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up from today — Aurelia POC: isolation, SOC 2 timeline, next steps

Hi Elena / Mike — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment: 

1) Summary of ask (from your side)
- POC to evaluate Redwood Private hosting inside Aurelia's VPC with strict network isolation and optional air-gapped mode for regulated workloads.
- Validate SOC 2 evidence + specific controls (logging, key management) prior to POC sign-off.

2) Action items we agreed on (owners + rough timelines)
- Aurelia: share current network diagram (redacted OK) & clarify whether PHI/PCI will be in scope (Elena) — target by EOD Wed (2026-07-22).
- Aurelia: confirm SOC 2 status (Type I/II), which controls are in scope and when the next audit report will be available (Elena).
- Redwood: provide a reference VPC isolation template and an initial architecture sketch for an air-gapped option (Jonas / Monica) — delivery by Fri (2026-07-24).
- Redwood: start vendor-security questionnaire exchange (Ben) — we will send first pass today.

3) Risks / clarifying points
- If Aurelia requires on-prem air-gap, lead time for hardware & confirmation of PMA/ops responsibilities will extend timelines.
- SOC 2 evidence gaps (e.g., if key rotation or HSM evidence is missing) may need compensating controls during the POC.

Attachments: redwood-poc-outline.pdf (high-level POC scope and success criteria).

Can you confirm the diagram share by Wed and SOC 2 status? Once we have those, Monica will drop the VPC sketch and we can lock a short follow-up (30–45m) to review.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this ahead.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192


From: elena.rossi@aurelia-labs.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: mike.turner@aurelia-labs.com
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — Aurelia POC: isolation, SOC 2 timeline, next steps

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the clear asks. Quick answers below and a redacted diagram attached.

- Diagram: attached 'aurelia-network-redacted.png' (redacted internal hostnames, shows VPC/subnet layout and where vendor endpoints are allowed).
- SOC 2: We have SOC 2 Type I report (Q1 2026). Type II audit started in May, auditor expected to issue report in mid-October 2026. We can share the Type I now and provide interim evidence for specific controls (e.g., logging configuration, IAM role change logs) if that helps for the POC.
- Data scope: For the POC, we expect only pseudonymized patient data; production may include limited PHI. We want to understand Redwood's recommended controls for PHI in private deployment.

Air-gap question: We are exploring an air-gapped option for a subset of workloads. Our preference is to test a VPC-isolated deployment first; if that looks good, we will evaluate the air-gap as a follow-on. Lead times: procurement for on-prem hardware is likely 8–12 weeks.

I'll attach the diagram link and a short note with expected procurement timing. Happy to jump on a review call after you share the VPC sketch.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Security, Aurelia Labs
elena.rossi@aurelia-labs.com

[Attachment: aurelia-network-redacted.png]


From: monica.patel@redwood.ai
To: elena.rossi@aurelia-labs.com, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — Aurelia POC: isolation, SOC 2 timeline, next steps

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround and the diagram. A couple of follow-ups / suggestions from our engineering side: 

- VPC template: we will use a dedicated VPC with two isolated subnets for Redwood inference nodes and a management subnet for control-plane traffic. No public IPs on inference nodes; NatGW only for controlled egress to patch mirrors (if needed).
- Network controls: recommend strict security groups + NACLs, flow logs forwarded to your central logging (or a locked S3) and a dedicated logging collector instance in the management subnet.
- KMS/HSM: if you require HSM-backed keys, Redwood can integrate with your KMS via external key agreement; please indicate preferred KMS vendor and whether tokenization/PHI encryption-at-rest is required for the POC.
- SOC 2 interim evidence: please share the Type I and any specific control artifacts you can surface (we'll accept logs with redaction). Those will help our risk team scope compensating controls for the POC window.

Attached: redwood-vpc-template.vsdx (starter diagram we will adapt over a short call). I'll also post a short readout in our docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/private-deploy-sandbox — that has sample templates and recommended controls.

Can we schedule a 45-minute review on Mon 27 Jul between 10–12 PT? If that works, Ben will send a calendar invite and the vendor questionnaire as an editable doc so you can drop answers inline.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai


From: mike.turner@aurelia-labs.com
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.rossi@aurelia-labs.com
Date: Fri, 24 Jul 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today — Aurelia POC: isolation, SOC 2 timeline, next steps

Thanks everyone — Monday 27 Jul 10:30 PT works for me.

Elena: we'll surface the Type I report and the redacted logging samples by EOD Mon; procurement timeline noted for the air-gap.

Monica / Ben: please include the vendor security questionnaire in the invite and a short checklist of mandatory controls we expect during the POC (network isolation, KMS integration, and logging delivery SLA). That will help our procurement and InfoSec teams triage quickly.

Looking forward to the call.

— Mike Turner
CTO, Aurelia Labs
